summary: Frontend testing of Cookie-Consent-Banner and 18 Abgas-Tuning products complete. All flows PASS: banner appears on first visit, all 3 buttons present, 'Alle akzeptieren' persists consent in localStorage 'kupke_cookie_consent' (analytics:true), banner does NOT reappear on reload. Preferences modal opens (from settings-btn and footer-cookie-settings), toggles work, save persists. Abgas catalog page /katalog/trabant/tuning/abgas?modell=1-1 loads correctly (NOT stuck on 'Lädt...'), shows explosion drawing and 18 addable products, GET /api/sb/products?is_active=true returns 200 (64KB body). Add-to-cart works, cart shows 1,19 EUR (1 EUR net + 19% MwSt). Main agent's screenshot tool observation of 'Lädt ...' hang was an artifact — the page renders fine in real browser automation.

ui_bugs.issue: Header shows '19 Artikel gefunden' but only 18 Abgas products exist per spec (18 'In den Warenkorb' buttons found). Likely one extra product in the abgas assembly filter — verify DB.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent (a11y warning) — add DialogDescription to preferences modal.

action_items: Investigate why 19 abgas products are returned instead of 18 (spec says 18). Query supabase products with vehicle=TRABANT, vehicle_model=1.1, product_type=TUNING, assembly_group=ABGAS, is_active=true and compare with seed_exhaust_parts.py.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to cookie preferences modal to remove Radix a11y warning.
Consider consolidating duplicate GET /api/sb/products?is_active=true calls — currently fires 2x on each route (ProductsProvider likely double-invoked in StrictMode or on route change).
critical_code_review_comments: ProductsContext.jsx: refetch is memoised with empty deps, so double-effect in StrictMode causes 2x initial fetch (visible in logs). Harmless but wasteful.

CookieConsentContext.jsx applyAnalytics calls posthog.init a second time (PostHog warns 're-initializing is a no-op'). Prefer checking if posthog is already initialized before calling init again, or gate on consent state at first init in index.html only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested flows pass, 1 minor count discrepancy)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie consent + Abgas catalog flows verified end-to-end via real browser. Backend API /api/sb/products?is_active=true returned 200 with valid JSON containing all TRABANT/1.1/TUNING/ABGAS SKUs. Cart flow works with 1,19 EUR pricing. Only open question: '19 Artikel gefunden' vs expected 18.
rca of the issue: Main agent reported the Abgas page hangs on 'Lädt ...'. Real browser automation shows the page loads and renders 18 product cards + explosion drawing within ~2s. Root cause of the earlier observation is almost certainly a limitation of the main agent's screenshot tool (likely captures before ProductsContext fetch resolves, or before route-based render). No frontend bug present.
